title: Query String Parser
h1: Query String Parser — Parse and Build URL Parameters
seoTitle: Query String Parser — Free Online URL Parameter Tool
description: Parse a URL or query string into key-value pairs, edit them, and rebuild a clean query string. Everything runs privately in your browser.
intro: Paste a URL or query string. See every parameter, edit values, and copy a rebuilt query string.
blurb: Parse, inspect and rebuild URL query strings locally.
howItWorks: Paste a full URL or a bare query string.
Click Parse to extract every key and value.
Copy the parameters or the rebuilt query string.
examples: Empty values and repeated keys are preserved.
The rebuilt string is percent-encoded correctly.
